👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Mumbai mein floods ekdum waise hain jaise door ke rishtedaar— Har saal bina bulaaye aa jaate hain, poora ghar barbaad karte hain, aur jaate jaate keh jaate hain: "Agli baar bhi aayenge!" Har saal June aate hi ek aam Mumbaikar sirf yahi sochta hai— is baar pehle ghar doobega ya office? 

Aur politicians? Unhone toh shayad maan hi liya hai ki Mumbai ka drainage Britishers bana gaye the, toh wahi aakar theek karenge. Aur hum Mumbai wale kya karte hain? Hum sirf memes banate hain, WhatsApp status lagate hain, aur paani mein doobte hue local train ki photo lekar likhte hain: "Spirit of Mumbai." 

Lekin Doston, masti mazaak se alawa, hume ye samajhna zaruri hai ki is problem ki wajah se— Har roz Mumbai ko 400 crore ka nuksaan hota hai. Hazaron daily wage workers aur chote businesses ko taklif hoti hai. Log bimar padkar marte hain. Aur har saal politicians Mumbai ko ignore karte hain! 

Toh sawaal ye hai ki— Mumbai ke drainage system ki halat itni kharab kyun hai? 
Hum is problem ko itne saalon baad bhi solve kyun nahi kar pa rahe? 
Aur Sarkar is problem ko solve kaise kar sakti hai?
